item.text: Could we consider a route with more benches or regular resting spots for our next outing? This would make the walk more comfortable and enjoyable for a wider range of participants, including people who may need occasional breaks because of mobility, stamina, age, or health considerations. A few planned pauses would also give everyone time to chat, enjoy the scenery, and stay together as a group, helping ensure that nobody feels pressured to keep up.
